fact: Ayrade, an Algerian operator listing on the Algiers stock exchange, says it operates two data centres, in Algiers and Oran, and sells sovereign cloud services to more than 10,000 business and institutional clients (El Watan, launch ceremony of 31 May 2026).

BTW Media reports that ADEX Technology operates its own data centre at Sidi Abdellah, certified by ARPCE since June 2020 and described as Tier II-ready, and sells ADEXCLOUD IaaS to SMEs, corporates and government agencies; no date of operation is given beyond the article's own publication date of 2025-07-15, which is used.

ICOSNET's technical sheet describes its operating Oran data centre at Bir El Djir as a 120 m2 colocation site with a 99.98% SLA, 2x100 kVA generators and international links over three subsea cables; the sheet gives no event date, so its 2021-11-16 file date is used.

DZWatch reports the inauguration of the I-Cloud sovereign data centre in the Akbou industrial zone (Bejaia), presided by the Knowledge Economy Minister, offering cloud hosting and computing to startups and SMEs; the inauguration date is not stated, so the article's 2026-10-04 date is used.
The Constantine data centre, inaugurated in February 2023 and run by Algerie Telecom, offers businesses and economic actors of the region a secure cloud platform.

Iconsnet operates two data centres, in Algiers and Oran, offering cloud computing and off-site backup; the article lists it among operators and private hosts selling colocation, dedicated servers and cloud (no date given, article of 2026-07-05).
The Constantine data centre has been operational since 2023, with cloud platforms for storing and processing the data of economic enterprises.

Algerie Telecom, the state telco, inaugurated its new Constantine data centre, built by its own teams and equipped with a cloud platform for collecting, processing and storing enterprise data; the document gives no event date beyond 'today' in a statement made 'this week', so its published date 2023-03-01 is used.

Algerie360's interview with AYRADE's founder describes AYRADE as a sovereign cloud operator with 3,700 active cloud customers and two operational data centres on national territory (facilities not named); the article gives no date for this, so its published date 2026-06-04 is used.
Data centres dataset: ICOSNET Algiers DATA CENTER (ICOSNET), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2026-03-12).
Le Jeune Indépendant says the centre, inaugurated 5 July 2026, hosts servers of administrations and companies that are its clients.
Le Jeune Indépendant says the Mohammadia complex of the Centre national des services numériques, inaugurated 5 July 2026, holds Uptime Institute Tier III Design certification.

Algerie Telecom inaugurated its own data centre in Constantine wilaya in February 2023, with a cloud platform to process and store businesses' data, according to the operator as reported by La Nouvelle Republique.
Private internet provider Icosnet deployed its second data centre, in Oran, in 2021 to meet market demand, after obtaining a cloud operating authorisation.

Les Enjeux Eco reports the national digital services centre holds an Uptime Tier III certification with 99.982% availability, on two interconnected sites at Mohammadia and Blida, hosting a government cloud and a public cloud for businesses, start-ups and individuals.
L'Echo d'Algerie says the Constantine data centre, operational since 2023, has cloud platforms for storing and processing the data of economic enterprises.

L'Echo d'Algerie says the Mohammadia data centre, built with Huawei and supervised by the High Commission for Digitalisation, holds the Uptime Institute Tier III Design certification and houses the national cloud.
Algérie Télécom's presentation to the ITU says that with its data centres it offers cloud services, connectivity and data security to outside customers.

Higher education minister Kamel Baddari inaugurated a national cloud computing platform hosted by Cerist in a data centre said to meet international standards, offering public institutions, companies and researchers hosting and processing at preferential tariffs.
